title: Chapter 303
text:
After returning to the sanctuary, Han Xiao locked Kerlodd in the secret base and checked his loot.

Godora Spear (Super Suitable)

Type: High-density Compressed Cold Weapon + Energy Evoking Light Enchantment

Quality: Green

Basic Stats: 247 – 255 Melee Attack, 294 – 381 Ranged Attack, 346 Energy Output

Requirements: LV 50 and above, 1,500 Energy

Length: 7 meters

Weight: 37 pounds

Energy Source: Level 3 Magic Rune

Origin: Godora Seventh Military Satellite, Chenguang Military Workshop, Assembly Line No. 248, Product Code: PV1324

Ability: [Golden Stinger] – Inject energy into the spear and activate the energy rune. Release a magic spike bullet at the tip of the spear. Each shot costs 5 Energy. Cooldown: 11 seconds every 20 shots.

Additional Effect: [Magic Affinity] – Using Mysterious Gold as raw material, + 12% Magic Resistance.

Additional Effect: [Portable Compression] – Compressed into a golden ball.

Remarks: Godora crafted weapon. Using Mysterious Gold as raw material, blessed by Light Magic. At the same time, high-density material compression technology is added into it. A mixture of retro vibe and advanced technology. It is a mixture of technology and magic. It can be used in both close-range and long-range attacks. It is one of the most common weapons in the Godora civilization.

These few golden balls were assembly line products, standard equipment for investigators. They were not made by Kerlodd himself. He was a standard Black Star Warrior. Mechanical Pugilists were more inclined to fight, and their interface was filled with basic knowledge.

The seven golden balls were all a mixture of technology and magic. Their interface Attack was two to three times higher than normal firearms. Together with the bonus from the Mechanic class, the difference was even bigger.

The standard equipment of advanced civilizations could be roughly divided into two types, the version suitable for ordinary people and the version suitable for Supers. Powerful individuals could withstand weapons with stronger recoil and use the effect of energy. The version suitable for ordinary people was equivalent to the gray grade + miscellaneous soldier model.

"Magic knowledge is not compatible with me. I can't reverse engineer the technology of these equipment. If it's the conventional path of pure machinery, then after the gunpowder gun is the stable electromagnetic gun. The attributes of the interface are about the same level."

Han Xiao nodded. The power of the standard equipment was also an indirect reflection of a civilization's strength. Godora was a Star System civilization, and according to the standards of the entire galaxy, it was neither high nor low. However, in the eyes of the people of Blue Star, those that could roam the galaxy were all advanced civilizations.

If the players wanted to create mixed technology equipment, they would need the cooperation of different classes. The Mechanic class would create the foundation, the Mage class would give the blessing, and there would be many restrictions on the details, and so on.

This was the first batch of interstellar equipment that Han Xiao had obtained. His favorite was the gun that shot out the beam cannon. Its name was very magical. It was called [Wrath of Garrett]. It had a range of 600 meters and an astonishing 500 damage on the interface. It could temporarily replace the Gauss sniper rifle and become the best explosive weapon to complement Flaming Will.

However, the most important thing for a Mechanic was still the machines that they could build themselves. This was the true combat strength of a Mechanic, and Han Xiao knew this very well. These new weapons could only be used as a transition.

After putting away the equipment, Han Xiao took out the interstellar communicator. His face became serious. This was the key item.

At this time, Kerlodd, who was thrown in the corner, opened his eyes slightly and saw Han Xiao playing with the interstellar communicator. He looked at him coldly and mockingly.

Although he had become a prisoner, Kerlodd still had a sense of superiority. He was sure that this Blue Star native did not know how to use the communicator. In his eyes, Han Xiao was like a monkey that had gotten a new toy.

An idea appeared in Kerlodd's mind, and he became excited. He doesn't know how to use these things, so he will definitely ask me how to use them. Maybe I can trick him and make him help me send a distress signal to the headquarters …

Kerlodd felt that this plan was more and more feasible. He was excited and saw hope.

At this time, Han Xiao opened the translucent crystal screen of the communicator and looked at the Godora language on the screen. He selected the option to change the language and changed it to Blue Star language. When Godora first came into contact with Blue Star, they entered the Blue Star language into their database. This was one of the things that they had to do when coming into contact with a new civilization. This way, they could analyze the language and make communication easier.

The interstellar communicator was a necessary tool for interstellar travel. Every player in his previous life had used it, so Han Xiao was very familiar with how to use it. He could use it with his eyes closed. He skillfully opened the login interface of his personal account, turned around, and looked at the confused Kerlodd. He said casually, "Kerlodd, right? It's good that you're awake. Tell me your personal account."

"How do you know how to use the communicator and know about my personal account? Who are you? " Kerlodd's eyes were filled with disbelief. He was shocked. How could a native know about these things?

There was only one explanation. This person was definitely not a native! He was also from the galaxy!

Thinking of this, Kerlodd's sense of superiority disappeared. He was shocked.

Originally, he had intended to use the name of Godora to threaten them, but this method was only effective against the natives. The galactic beings were not afraid of such an illusory threat. With the restriction of distance and the peace treaty, using the name of one's civilization to threaten the other party would not work at all. Furthermore, he was just a small investigator, not a big shot.

"Who am I?" Han Xiao curled his lips and said mysteriously, "We're in a hurry to meet, so let me formally introduce myself. My name is Han Xiao. As for the rest, you don't need to know."

Kerlodd was more and more sure of his guess. He felt that Han Xiao was very mysterious. When he looked into Han Xiao's eyes, it was as if he saw an abyss of fog. He suddenly realized something and said, "No, how do you know my name?"

Han Xiao said slowly, "You're an investigator from Godora. You were ordered to come to Blue Star to investigate the so-called 'Inhuman Incident', but for some reason, your spaceship crashed."

"Are you a mind reader or a foreseer?" Kerlodd was alert. He secretly activated his energy to protect his mind, but he did not find any signs of being invaded.

"Guess," Han Xiao said jokingly.

This attitude made Kerlodd very angry, but he had to lower his head. He controlled his anger and asked, "Why did you attack me?"

Han Xiao pointed at the communicator and said, "Don't worry, this is not personal. I don't have any animosity toward Godora. I just want this thing."

"You call this not having any animosity?" Kerlodd angrily struggled against the electromagnetic lock on the mechanical chain.

Han Xiao sat on the sofa, put his hands on his knees, leaned forward, and stared at the Godora man with a threatening look. He said lightly, "If I had any animosity toward you, you would already be dead."

Kerlodd's face froze, and he said, "You just think that I'm still useful."

"Correct answer, no reward." Han Xiao smiled.

"I just need the communicator to contact the Galactic Travel Agency and leave this planet. We're not enemies. Your spaceship crash has nothing to do with me. I attacked you just to make sure nothing goes wrong. Plus, I know how arrogant Godora people are. I'll beat you up first before we talk. Now, I have a deal to discuss with you. Hmm … but you don't have the right to reject it. "

Kerlodd clenched his teeth. "Speak!"

"I need to borrow money from your personal account. If you're willing to cooperate, I can let you go and take you with me. You can go home whenever you want."

Kerlodd was surprised. "You're willing to let me go?"

"Why not?" Han Xiao could not help but laugh. "I have no enmity with Godora, and I only want to rob them of their wealth and not their lives. I also did not hurt you that much, right? Or is it because you were defeated by me that you feel resentful and want to take revenge?"

Kerlodd thought about it carefully. Indeed, Han Xiao's direct conflict with him was just a fight. Losing was one thing, but Han Xiao did not hurt him severely and even gave him a chance to go home. Godora had an ancient tradition of worshipping the strong. Plus, he was an investigator, so fighting was nothing to him.

Although he was still a little depressed, Kerlodd's anger slowly calmed down.

He thought about it and said seriously, "As long as you fulfill your end of the deal, I'm willing to cooperate. I can promise God Gal that I will not take revenge. I admit defeat."
